Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SPACE SYSTEMS**

At Rocket Lab, we're not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

We are currently seeking a **Flight Software Engineer II** for our team based out of headquarters in Long Beach, CA . In this role, you will play a key role in supporting the development of flight software for our Space Systems programs. You'll spend your days participating in all aspects of software design and development, from requirements definition through coding and testing. And when we say test, we mean your software will be on orbit within weeks and months, not years. Thanks to having our own rockets and launch sites, we have frequent opportunities to test and operate our software on orbit. To be successful in this role, you must want to see your software make a big impact on the way we explore space and use it as a platform for discovery and innovation. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space!

* Develop hardware drivers to interface to Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs), Star Trackers, Reaction Wheels and other spacecraft sensors and actuators
* Develop and maintain comprehensive unit tests to run within a Continuous Integration framework
* Collaborate with hardware-in-the-loop test engineers to verify and validate combined software and hardware functionality
* Collaborate with systems engineers and embedded systems engineers in developing, documenting and validating requirements
* Participate in review of source code changes and ensure all changes meet company coding standards
* Participate in design reviews such as a PDR and CDR
* Assist with on-orbit (and interplanetary) flight operations

* Bachelor's degree in aerospace engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or equivalent technical degree

* Proficiency in C and C++ languages
* Experience with Real Time Operating Systems (RTOS) or with Embedded Linux
* Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance
* U.S. citizenship is required, due to program requirements

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Active Secret or TS/SCI security clearance
* Rust programming language
* Advanced Degree
* Experience developing software and drivers with CAN/CAN-FD and/or UDP/TCP within an embedded system
* Experience developing software for autonomous vehicles operating in harsh environments, such as satellites or autonomous vehicles

*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Integrations
jobs.description:
### **Why TrueML?**

TrueML is a mission-driven financial software company that aims to create better customer experiences for distressed borrowers. Consumers today want personal, digital-first experiences that align with their lifestyles, especially when it comes to managing finances. TrueML’s approach uses machine learning to engage each customer digitally and adjust strategies in real time in response to their interactions.

The TrueML team includes inspired data scientists, financial services industry experts and customer experience fanatics building technology to serve people in a way that recognizes their unique needs and preferences as human beings and endeavoring toward ensuring nobody gets locked out of the financial system.

### **About the Role**

As a Senior Engineer on the True Integrations (TI) team at TrueML, you will be a key technical contributor to how client data enters our platform. That includes the serverless, config-driven integration platform we are building on our modern platform, the PCI tokenization services that keep sensitive data out of our systems, and the established integration services that still serve major clients while we migrate them to the new platform.

You will take full ownership of complex technical work, set a high engineering bar, and actively help elevate the engineers around you. The team builds with AI rather than just alongside it: most of a developer's day is spent working with LLM coding agents (Claude) to get tasks done, our repositories ship agent-readable context, and we are adding LLM-backed services to our own pipelines. In partnership with your Engineering Manager, Product, Program Management, and sibling teams across the Data org, you will translate client and business requirements into well-architected solutions, with a strong bias toward reliability, security, and measurability.

### **What You'll Do:**

* **Technical Delivery**: Own complex engineering tickets end-to-end, from design through implementation, testing, and production. Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and hold that standard in review.
* **Technical Design & Architecture**: Author and review Technical Design Documents (TDDs) and contribute to Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). Lead technical discussions within your domain and help the team make sound, well-documented trade-offs.
* **Integration Platform**: Build and evolve our next-generation integration platform: SFTP, REST API, and S3 ingestion entry points; Step Functions preprocessing (file transfer, PGP decryption, validation); a compute-agnostic Transformation Engine that runs on both Lambda and Glue; and event publishing to downstream consumers and client webhooks. Drive the platform toward low-code, config-driven client onboarding.
* **Sensitive Data & Tokenization**: Own and harden the services that keep PANs and PII protected: format-preserving tokenization, PGP key management and rotation, SFTP relays, and redaction, all running in an isolated PCI environment. Our hardest success metric is zero unencrypted cardholder data entering the platform.
* **Client Data Contracts & Infrastructure as Code**: Map client file and API formats into our canonical internal data schema (OTDS), and manage schema versioning and compatibility. Treat infrastructure as a first-class deliverable: Terraform-based client provisioning and environments, alongside CDK for the services you inherit.
* **Legacy Systems & Migration**: Operate and improve the established integration services that serve our largest clients, including a Kubernetes-based file-processing platform and dedicated client APIs. Help migrate clients off them safely. Reduce the long tail of under-documented inherited systems by turning tribal knowledge into runbooks and alerts with clear ownership.
* **Client Go-Lives**: Partner with Implementations, Solutions Engineering, and operations teams to bring new clients live: integration setup, dry runs, cutover, and hypercare.
* **AI-Assisted Engineering**: Use AI coding agents as a primary part of your workflow and improve how the team uses them. That means maintaining repo context and skill files, building and consuming MCP servers that expose our tools safely, and codifying investigation-heavy work (triage, file reprocessing, client data questions) into reusable agent workflows. Help design and build the LLM-backed services we are adding to our pipelines, including prompt and context design, structured output and tool calling, validation loops, and model selection. Manage token budgets and cost with the same rigor as any other infrastructure spend.
* **Reliability & Observability**: Own the operational health of your systems and take part in on-call. Instrument pipelines with meaningful signals (file- and record-level failures, SLA breaches, DLQ depth, latency), and replace manual failure reviews with automated monitoring.
* **Mentorship & Technical Leadership**: Support the growth of more junior engineers through code review, pairing, and direct feedback, including raising the team's effectiveness with AI tooling. Lead spikes and timeboxed discovery work within your domain.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration**: Partner with Data Services, Data Engineering, Data Science, and Product to define clear data contracts and coordinate schema changes, so that the client data we ingest is fit for downstream consumers.

### **Who You Are:**

* **Education & Experience**: Bachelor's degree in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Track Record:** 5+ years of software or data engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production systems. No people management requirement.
* **Technical Mastery**: Deep experience building data ingestion or integration systems: file- and API-based pipelines, idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling, and reprocessing. Strong AWS fundamentals, especially serverless and data services (Lambda, Step Functions, Glue, S3, EventBridge, Transfer Family)

As a Senior Engineer on the True Integrations (TI) team at TrueML, you will be a key technical contributor to how client data enters our platform. You will take full ownership of complex technical work, set a high engineering bar, and actively help elevate the engineers around you. The team builds with AI rather than just alongside it: most of a developer's day is spent working with LLM coding agents (Claude) to get tasks done, our repositories ship agent-readable context, and we are adding LLM-backed services to our own pipelines.
